interface.signature: def canFinish(self, numCourses: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of courses must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= course < numCourses for course in range(numCourses))
preconditions.description: All course labels must be within the valid range from 0 to n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(pair) == 2 and 0 <= pair[0] < numCourses and 0 <= pair[1] < numCourses for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite pair must contain exactly two valid course labels.

postconditions.description: If it is possible to finish all courses, the function returns True.
If it is impossible to finish all courses due to circular dependencies, the function returns False.
